description:
One due-diligence report on a token: identity, market (price, market cap, FDV, volume), liquidity (top DEX pools), holder concentration and contract safety, each with its own source. Use it for "is this token real, liquid and safe?" A name that several tokens share returns the candidates instead of a report. Example: {"token":"PEPE"} or {"token":"0x6982508145454ce325ddbe47a25d4ec3d2311933","chain":"eth"}.

Costs 5 credits; each optional sections entry (supply, insights, top_traders) adds 1. Every section carries its own source receipt (provider, fetched_at, runtime_status); a section that fails is listed under missing and never guessed.

chain.description: Chain of the contract, for example "eth", "base" or "solana". A 0x address with no chain is read as Ethereum.

detail.description: summary (default) trims each section; full returns more rows.

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data (default) or 'markdown' for human-readable text.

sections.description: Default: identity, market, liquidity, holders, safety. Optional: supply, insights (CoinGecko AI summary, unverified), top_traders.

token.description: A ticker, CoinGecko id, name or contract address.

name: research_token
